details.description: DeepSeek-V3.1 is DeepSeek's hybrid-reasoning chat model, released August 21, 2025 per DeepSeek's own API changelog. Per its Hugging Face model card it combines 'thinking' and 'non-thinking' response modes in one model, selected via the chat template, built on the same Mixture-of-Experts architecture as DeepSeek-V3, with added post-training for tool use, a Code Agent and a Search Agent. DeepSeek's own changelog shows the deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner endpoints have since moved on through DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus and V3.2 to newer DeepSeek-V4 models.
advantages: Scores 84.8 on MMLU-Pro in thinking mode, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 80.1 on GPQA-Diamond, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 93.1 on AIME, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 66.0 on SWE-bench Verified in agent mode, per its Hugging Face model card.
Combines a 'thinking' and a 'non-thinking' response mode in one model, selectable via the chat template, per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: DeepSeek's own changelog shows the deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner endpoint names have since moved on to newer DeepSeek-V4 models, so this checkpoint is no longer served under those default aliases.
Superseded about a month later by DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus, which DeepSeek's own changelog credits with better language consistency and agent performance.
Text only; no image or audio input or output.
use_cases: General-purpose chat with a switchable thinking/non-thinking mode.
Agentic workflows using a Code Agent and a Search Agent for tool use.
Enterprise retrieval-augmented generation, per Fireworks AI's hosting page.

notes: Catalog's facts for this target (max_input_tokens 128000, max_output_tokens 8192) are corroborated by DeepSeek's own Hugging Face model card, whose download table lists a 128K context length for DeepSeek-V3.1, matching the catalog value. Fireworks' own product page states a larger 163,840-token context length for its own hosted deployment of this model; that is a host-specific serving limit, not a contradiction of the maker's stated figure, so no conflict remains. Total parameter count also differs by source: the Hugging Face model card text states 671B total / 37B activated, while Fireworks' page and Hugging Face's own metadata sidebar show 685B; likely reflects whether the multi-token-prediction module is counted, so no figure is stated in the description. No public GitHub repository specific to V3.1 was found.
